propositions: The reconciler lacks a config-driven backend selection mechanism; vendors are currently implicit in module imports.
A new reconciler.backend field must be added to ReconcilerConfig with static validation via _as_choice coercer, defaulting to 'jira' with REBAR_RECONCILER_BACKEND env override support.
A registry module with register() decorator, select_backend(config) resolver, and _reset_registry_for_test context manager enables runtime backend lookup without rewiring existing consumers.
JiraBackend must be registered via @register('jira') decorator in adapters/jira/backend.py, with adapters/__init__.py importing the jira backend module to trigger registration side-effects.
select_backend() must lazily import rebar_reconciler.adapters internally to populate the registry before key lookup, avoiding circular imports and ensuring deterministic registration.
No existing consumer call sites (_load_acli, AcliClient construction, differ/apply modules) are modified in this story; rewiring is deferred to S4.
